data.long_meaning: Rooted in the Sanskrit language, Sushant is derived from the words ‘shush’ meaning ‘quiet’ and ‘asan’ meaning ‘seated’. This name symbolizes a steadfast and calm individual who is firmly rooted in their beliefs and values. In Hindu mythology, Sushant is also the name of a sage and a celestial being, emphasizing the spiritual and philosophical connection to this name.

He was a key figure in the Indian Independence Movement and played an important role in the planning and execution of various revolutionary activities against the British Raj. He was also a prominent member of the Indian National Congress.

Sushant Singh Rajput was a popular Indian actor who appeared in Bollywood films. He was born on January 21, 1986, in Patna, Bihar, India. He rose to fame with his role in the television soap opera 'Kis Desh Mein Hai Meraa Dil' and went on to act in films such as 'Kai Po Che!', 'MS Dhoni: The Untold Story', and 'Shoodh Sapna Ka Jhankar'. He tragically passed away on June 14, 2020, in an apparent suicide.
